title: Motion Words
description: An interactive learning platform for sign language education. Learn BISINDO, SIBI, and  ASL through visual tutors, word translation, and voice interaction to bridging Indonesian sign language to the world.

title: Customer Segmentation
description: This research applies unsupervised machine learning, K-Means and Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), to segment over 700,000 e-commerce transactions from the Kaggle "Online Retail II" dataset into four meaningful customer behavior clusters: Loyal, Dormant Loyal, Lost, and New Customers.
